evidence.observation: T701 reads 399.3 °C, versus 59.27–64.4 °C on these column temperature channels; the large discrepancy persists from the first event and requires verification.
Reflux reads 0.001 L/h while distillate reads 0.465 L/h and the reported flow ratio is 5.878; this is inconsistent with a contemporaneous reflux/distillate ratio.
Reflux rises to 1.862 L/h with distillate 0.318 L/h, giving a measured ratio of about 5.86 versus reported FYI702 of 7.27; earlier reflux readings repeatedly approached zero.

System pressure remains near 300 mbar (299.74 currently), pressure differences are -0.06 and 2.1 mbar, and both level switches remain 1; these do not identify the cause of the temperature and flow discrepancies.
